stories.title: Supreme Court suggests fresh look at KMC delimitation case
stories.summary: The Supreme Court indicated an inclination to set aside a Calcutta High Court order that paused Kolkata Municipal Corporation elections. The bench suggested the High Court hear the delimitation dispute afresh. The apex court is currently reviewing an appeal filed by the West Bengal government against the stay.

stories.title: Governor seeks report on Karthigai Deepam lamp placement
stories.summary: Governor Rajendra Vishwanath Arlekar has requested a report from Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay regarding compliance with Supreme Court directions for the Karthigai Deepam. The ceremonial lamp was lit at a traditional spot rather than the court-mandated location atop the Thirupparankundram hillock. The Governor invoked Article 167(b).

stories.title: Police say no permission sought for anti-SIR protest march
stories.summary: Delhi Police officials stated that no permission was sought for a November 26 protest march against the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls. Organisers claim they sent an intimation to the police. The march is planned from Valmiki Sadan to Jantar Mantar to demand the revision be scrapped.

stories.title: ECI mandates Form 8 for electoral roll corrections
stories.summary: The Election Commission of India directed that erroneous entries flagged during the Special Summary Revision must be corrected using Form 8. Officials will verify changes against data from the Special Intensive Revision rather than using automated matching. Form 8 is the standard application for correcting voter details.

stories.title: Congress and Samajwadi Party seat-sharing talks stall
stories.summary: Frictions between the Congress and Samajwadi Party increased after the SP unilaterally declared candidates for five seats. Congress leaders criticised the move while seat-sharing talks remain ongoing. The Congress rejected an initial offer of 26 seats, with a state leader noting the party is not a beggar.

stories.title: Yogi Adityanath says SP-Congress alliance failed early
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath remarked that the alliance between the Samajwadi Party and Congress has failed before the elections. He cited the simultaneous occurrence of seat-sharing meetings and unilateral candidate announcements as a sign of humiliation. The Chief Minister was reacting to recent candidate declarations.

stories.title: Supreme Court cancels bail for former Karnataka Minister
stories.summary: The Supreme Court cancelled the bail and suspension of life sentence for former Karnataka Minister Vinay Kulkarni in a 2016 murder case. The court termed the High Court's decision to grant bail perverse, directing Kulkarni to surrender within two weeks to serve his life term.

stories.title: BJP to decide Chief Minister after election results
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya stated that the BJP will choose its Chief Ministerial candidate through consensus among elected MLAs after the upcoming election. He noted the party fights on its lotus symbol and that leadership decisions follow elaborate deliberations after the polls conclude.

stories.title: Supreme Court orders Vinay Kulkarni to surrender
stories.summary: The Supreme Court set aside a Karnataka High Court order that stayed the conviction and sentence of former legislator Vinay Kulkarni. The court held that long pendency of criminal appeals is not grounds to suspend sentences in grave offences. Kulkarni must surrender within two weeks.

stories.title: Governor asks Chief Minister for explanation on lamp site
stories.summary: Governor Rajendra Arlekar has asked Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay to explain why the ceremonial lamp at Tirupparankundram was lit at a traditional site instead of the Supreme Court-mandated stone pillar. The Governor invoked Article 167(b) of the Constitution to request information on the administration.

stories.title: Supreme Court orders fresh hearing on Rahul Gandhi assets probe
stories.summary: The Supreme Court set aside an Allahabad High Court order that directed the CBI and ED to investigate allegations of disproportionate assets against Rahul Gandhi. The bench passed the order on a petition filed by Gandhi and requested a fresh hearing on the matter.

stories.title: BJP leadership to determine Chief Minister post-election
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya stated that the BJP will select its Chief Minister through consensus among elected MLAs following the assembly elections. He noted that the party currently operates under the leadership of Yogi Adityanath, but future decisions remain subject to post-poll deliberations.

stories.title: Three killed in road accident in Tiruvannamalai
stories.summary: Three members of a family were killed on Wednesday when a car hit their two-wheeler on the Chittoor-Cuddalore High Road. The deceased included a teacher and his wife. Their nine-year-old son was injured in the collision. Police are investigating the incident.

stories.title: Man arrested for wife's murder in Vellore
stories.summary: A 31-year-old man was arrested by Sathuvachari police for the murder of his wife following a family dispute. The couple had reportedly argued frequently over financial issues. The victim had been living at her parents' house with their two children prior to the incident.

stories.title: Burglars target tribal family home in Tirupattur
stories.summary: Burglars stole 15 sovereigns of gold and cash from a house near Jolarpet on Wednesday. The owner, who belongs to the Irular community, discovered the theft upon returning from a festival. The intruders gained access by damaging the rear door of the residence.

stories.title: Farmers protest for loan waivers in 35 districts
stories.summary: Farmers across 35 districts staged protests demanding the state government waive agricultural loans in cooperative banks. The protesters cited a previous poll promise. The government recently requested that farmers repay existing loans by November 30 to become eligible for new credit.

stories.title: Gallantry awardees granted free travel on all trains
stories.summary: The Ministry of Railways has extended complimentary travel facilities for Chakra-series gallantry awardees to include all trains, such as the Vande Bharat Express. The benefit, which covers First Class and AC 2-Tier, is also available to widows of posthumous award recipients and a companion.

stories.title: Three arrested for murder in D.J. Halli
stories.summary: Three men were arrested by D.J. Halli police for beating their friend to death following a dispute over a motorcycle. The victim and the accused were reportedly staying together in a room. Police stated the assault involved repeated punches to the face and body.

stories.title: Family disputes turn fatal in Karnataka
stories.summary: In two separate incidents, a 55-year-old woman allegedly killed her son over his choice of spouse, while a 42-year-old man allegedly killed his sister during a property dispute. Both cases are currently under police investigation in Tumakuru and Bengaluru.

stories.title: MVD fines vehicles for overloading and violations
stories.summary: The Motor Vehicles department imposed penalties totaling ₹5.27 lakh on Wednesday for various infractions, including overloading, invalid permits, and unlicensed driving. Inspections were conducted across six locations to address non-compliance with transport regulations.

stories.title: Rice prices rise as district officials limit stocks
stories.summary: Retail prices for Sona Masoori rice have doubled to ₹100-120 per kg. In response to the sustained increase, the district administration has directed millers and traders to cap their holdings. Rice millers are now permitted to store a maximum of 400 tonnes.

stories.title: Husband arrested following dowry death in Uttar Pradesh
stories.summary: A 32-year-old woman died under suspicious circumstances in Ballia after an alleged dispute over a dowry demand for a motorcycle. Police have arrested her husband, Shashi Prakash Rai, following a complaint filed by the victim's father naming several family members.

stories.title: Murder accused attacked outside Pune court
stories.summary: A man identified as Mandar Kivde was attacked by four armed assailants outside the Shivajinagar court on Wednesday. The victim, who was recently released on bail in a 2025 murder case, remains in critical condition following the assault.

stories.title: Three killed in highway collision near Behror
stories.summary: Three men died and two others were seriously injured after their vehicle crashed into a trolley on the Delhi-Jaipur National Highway late Tuesday. The victims were returning to their village when the driver lost control of the vehicle near the Dahmi flyover.

stories.title: Management alumni association hosts sports festival
stories.summary: The IIM Bangalore Alumni Association is hosting a two-day sports festival starting November 28. The event aims to gather 500 alumni and 115 corporate leaders from 21 management institutions to participate in a shared sporting platform.

stories.title: SRM University-A.P. partners with AiDEM for Japanese recruitment
stories.summary: SRM University-A.P. has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Japanese firm AiDEM to create recruitment pathways for graduates. The partnership marks the firm's first academic engagement in India, focusing on facilitating international employment opportunities for students.

stories.title: Karnataka reduces Nandini curd price
stories.summary: Following a directive from the Chief Minister, the Karnataka Milk Federation will lower the price of Nandini curd by ₹2 per kg starting November 29. The cooperative previously revised prices on November 1, but stated the new reduction is in the interest of consumers.

stories.title: Andhra Pradesh expands subsidised rice sales
stories.summary: Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu has ordered the expansion of subsidised Dharani rice sales to 500 centres. Officials were also directed to supply tur dal and palm oil through fair price shops at fixed rates to mitigate the impact of rising commodity prices.

stories.title: Assam signs data centre agreement with Bharti Airtel
stories.summary: The Assam government has signed a memorandum of understanding with Bharti Airtel to establish two advanced data centres in the state. The project aims to expand digital infrastructure and improve the state's technological capabilities.

stories.title: Karnataka proposes sustainable data centre in Mangaluru
stories.summary: The state government has proposed a 20-acre site at Tannirbhavi for what it describes as India's first sustainable data centre. The project remains subject to technical and environmental assessments before it can be presented to potential investors.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu hosts investment conclave
stories.summary: The second edition of the VETTRI Investment and Conversion Conclave began Wednesday in Mahabalipuram. Officials expect to sign over 70 memorandums of understanding with multi-national companies during the event, representing significant planned investments in the state.

stories.title: SpiceJet crew reports operational issues
stories.summary: SpiceJet staff have flagged concerns regarding ground holds, crew fatigue, and unpaid dues. A recent letter cited an incident where a Q400 aircraft was denied departure clearance at Mumbai airport, reportedly due to the airline's pending financial obligations.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu signs 78 investment agreements
stories.summary: The state government signed 78 memorandums of understanding on Wednesday, representing investments worth ₹58,214 crore. Officials estimate the projects will generate over 65,000 jobs. The Chief Minister also inaugurated six projects and laid the foundation stone for 15 others.

stories.title: Tiruvannamalai clears waste after Maha Deepam
stories.summary: Sanitary workers removed over 600 tonnes of waste generated during the Maha Deepam festival. The cleanup operation involved staff from the local corporation and the District Rural Development Agency working in shifts to clear streets and the Girivalam path.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu dissents on Cauvery water release
stories.summary: The Tamil Nadu government recorded its dissent at a meeting of the Cauvery Water Management Authority regarding a directive to release 2,000 cusecs of water. The state argued the decision did not align with established data or previous judicial awards.

stories.title: Great Nicobar project hearing deferred
stories.summary: The Calcutta High Court deferred the final hearing on petitions challenging the ₹92,000 crore Great Nicobar Island project. The Centre requested additional time to file documents regarding tribal rights, a point of contention between the government and petitioners.

stories.title: Deficient monsoon leaves Udaipur lakes shrinking
stories.summary: Udaipur's 178 reservoirs now hold 814.99 million cubic metres of water, or 44.04 percent of total capacity. The lakes that define the city's tourism-dependent economy are seeing declining levels following a deficient monsoon. Fateh Sagar and Swaroop Sagar were at capacity last November, but are now lower.

stories.title: Former bureaucrats urge cancellation of Demwe dam project
stories.summary: A group of 69 former bureaucrats has asked the environment ministry to scrap the 1,750 MW Demwe Lower Hydroelectric Project on the Lohit River. They cite risks to biodiversity and the fragile Himalayan ecology. The project was acquired by the Greenko Group in 2026 after previous financial stalls.

stories.title: Mobile wildlife forensic lab to move to Coimbatore
stories.summary: The Forest Department will relocate its mobile wildlife forensic-cum-diagnostic laboratory from Tiruchi to Pethikuttai in the Coimbatore forest range. The move follows a directive from a Special Division Bench of the Madras High Court. The facility is expected to arrive at the new site in December.

stories.title: Study finds elephant relocation fails to stop conflict
stories.summary: A four-member expert panel concluded that translocating wild elephants does not solve human-elephant conflict in Chinnakkanal. The findings follow local demands to remove a tusker named Chakkakompan. The panel was formed in September by the District Collector to address rising tensions between residents and the animals.

stories.title: India separates Hasina return plans from extradition process
stories.summary: India's Ministry of External Affairs stated that the potential return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and the process of her extradition are separate issues. The government is examining the extradition request from Bangladesh's interim administration in line with established processes. The ministry expressed concern over current regional stability.

stories.title: Indian Ocean must connect nations, not divide them: NSA Ajit Doval at Colombo Security Conclave
stories.summary: Addressing the 8th National Security Advisors' Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave (CSC) in Male, Doval called for sustained cooperation among countries. stories.title: Ganga Water Treaty About To Lapse, Dhaka Makes Tough Demand From India
stories.summary: When the flow is 70,000 cubic feet per second (cusecs) or less, the two countries share it equally.

There are, however, several routes through which the proposed duties could be modified, suspended or eventually withdrawn. Also

stories.title: India's satellite supply chain relies on imports
stories.summary: A report by IN-SPACe states that India's satellite industry remains highly dependent on imports for critical components. While the private space sector is growing, its current contribution is largely limited to structural assemblies. The national space economy is valued at approximately 9 billion dollars.

stories.title: Meta meets Congress leaders following bias allegations
stories.summary: Meta representatives met with Congress party officials in Delhi at the company's request. The meeting followed protests by the Indian Youth Congress over alleged bias in content moderation and the suspension of Instagram accounts. Neither party has provided an official comment on the discussions held on Tuesday.

stories.title: Skyroot Aerospace CEO predicts global space power status
stories.summary: Skyroot Aerospace CEO Pawan Kumar Chandana stated that India is poised to become a major global space power. Speaking at the Vikram Sarabhai Memorial Lecture, he noted that Indian talent is expected to drive significant advancements in the sector over the coming decades.

stories.title: Meta officials meet Congress leaders after protests over restrictions on party’s social media accounts

I cover digital policy and the intersection of technology and society, focusing mainly on what's happening in India. My beat often involves tracking platform regulation, privacy, internet curbs, and the real-world impact

stories.title: India's first private-built PSLV rocket delayed again
stories.summary: The project, valued at 860 crore rupees, faces further delays. The PSLV remains one of the most dependable launch vehicles operated by ISRO, though the private-sector version continues to wait for its debut. The timeline for the launch remains unconfirmed.

stories.title: GAIL plans data centre foray with 5 MW facility
stories.summary: GAIL is proposing an equal joint venture to develop its first 5 MW data centre in Faridabad. The state-run company owns land parcels across four states and maintains an extensive optical fibre network. It is currently seeking a strategic partner to manage the expansion.

stories.title: Airtel to invest 1,200 crore in Assam data centres
stories.summary: Bharti Airtel plans to construct three data centres in Assam with a total investment of 1,200 crore rupees. The company will allocate 700 crore rupees to a facility in Guwahati, with the remaining 500 crore rupees split between projects in Jorhat and Silchar.

stories.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
stories.summary: Nvidia has reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO following pressure from Donald Trump. Huang had previously resigned after revelations of extramarital affairs involving a former executive at a firm with alleged ties to Chinese intelligence. The decision has prompted concern among US lawmakers regarding chip security.

stories.title: South Florida braces for more flooding
stories.summary: A low-pressure system is bringing intense rainfall to South Florida, threatening to worsen flooding in Broward and Miami-Dade counties. Meteorologists warn that saturated ground from last week's historic storms puts Thanksgiving travel at risk. Major roads remain submerged as the region faces severe weather.

stories.title: Minnesota wolves alter pond formation
stories.summary: A study in Science Advances reports that gray wolves in Voyageurs National Park influence wetland development by hunting beavers. By reducing the beaver population, wolves disrupt the construction of dams and the storage of over 51 million gallons of water annually. Nature has its own infrastructure managers.

stories.title: Surgeons remove large pancreatic stones via keyhole surgery
stories.summary: A 41-year-old patient underwent laparoscopic surgery to remove pancreatic stones measuring up to 3 cm. The procedure, performed at GEM Hospital, left the patient with no abdominal scars or stitches. The patient was discharged four days after the surgery addressed his chronic calcific pancreatitis.

stories.title: Women’s Commission seeks investigation into oocyte racket
stories.summary: The Telangana State Women’s Commission has asked the Governor to order a special investigation into an illegal egg harvesting racket busted in Hyderabad. The Commission alleges the network exploited poor and middle-class women. A high-level committee has been requested to ensure an impartial inquiry.

stories.title: Karnataka collects 17,778 units of blood in state-wide drive
stories.summary: Karnataka collected 17,778 units of blood from 21,150 donors during a state-wide drive on Wednesday. The event, held to mark National Voluntary Blood Donation Day, involved 270 centres. Health Minister U.T. Khader inaugurated the programme and participated as a donor.

stories.title: Surat doctor sentenced for medical negligence
stories.summary: A Surat court sentenced Dr Pareshkumar Bhajiyawala to two years in jail for medical negligence during the 2009 treatment of Ismail Darbar’s mother. The court also imposed a fine of 1,000 rupees. The conviction followed a 95-page judgment regarding grievous injuries sustained by the patient.

stories.title: Patient found dead in Thrissur hospital washroom
stories.summary: A 77-year-old patient was found dead in a washroom at Thrissur Government Medical College Hospital, 36 hours after he went missing from his ward. Police are currently reviewing CCTV footage to determine the circumstances of the incident. The hospital has not provided further details.

stories.title: Military doctors perform 412 eye surgeries in Meerut
stories.summary: Military doctors from the Army Hospital performed 412 free, sight-restoring surgeries at a camp in Meerut. The initiative, part of Operation Drishti, aims to provide advanced eye care to remote areas. The defence ministry confirmed the surgeries were completed on Wednesday.

stories.title: 53 hospitalised after eating roadside shawarma
stories.summary: Fifty-three people were hospitalised in Maharashtra after consuming shawarma from a roadside eatery. Local authorities are investigating the incident as patients receive treatment for food poisoning. The eatery has been identified as the source of the outbreak.

stories.title: Tamil Nadu to vaccinate high-risk workers against rabies
stories.summary: Tamil Nadu has sanctioned 2.22 crore rupees to provide rabies vaccinations to over one lakh high-risk workers. The initiative covers animal handlers and dog catchers across 38 districts. The programme is part of the state's vision to eliminate dog-mediated rabies by 2030.

stories.title: Missing patient found dead in hospital washroom
stories.summary: The body of 79-year-old Makutti Ravuthar was found in a washroom at Thrissur Medical College Hospital, 36 hours after he disappeared from his ward. Sanitation workers discovered the body after noticing a door had been locked for an unusually long time. Security staff forced the door open.

stories.title: Anant Singh hosts wedding with 150 dishes
stories.summary: Anant Singh planned for four to five lakh guests at his daughter's wedding. The event featured a menu of more than 150 dishes. The family described the scale of the celebration as a fair.

stories.title: Sukhbir Badal faces backlash over past DNA comments
stories.summary: Sukhbir Badal previously stated that the DNA of any Sikh joining the BJP should be examined. AAP and Congress are now using the 2024 remark against him. Political rhetoric has a way of returning to the source.
